why: Every artifact here is derived. Committing a derived artifact without a way to re-derive it is how a paper ends up describing an earlier state of its own evidence: the generator is correct, the file is committed, and nothing compares them. The programme conformance check re-derives each one. The registry declares a generator script and flag names only, never a command line, so it cannot introduce an interpreter or a payload.

artifacts.note: Scale facts cited by the manuscript as macros. A stale value here would put a wrong task count into the abstract.
Benchmark/licence/freeze manifest. Its parity with the audit JSON is the reason a reader can trust either.
